commit.message:
fix(b4-award-readiness): presentation-integrity repair - actual launcher verdicts, ten-scene contract, unified screenshot register

Launcher verdict truth (W24 scope): both demo launchers previously printed a
fixed SAFE_TO_RETIRE = BLOCKED summary on any zero exit. New shared classifier
scripts/launcher_verdict.py reads the production CLI's structured --out record
(termivance.supervised_review/v1) and classifies the ACTUAL result - only
VERDICT_CONFIRMED_BLOCKED (completed-now execution + live provider steps +
verdict BLOCKED) is presented as the expected safe outcome; unsuccessful
execution, missing/malformed results, non-live mode, incomplete steps, missing
live evidence, undetermined/inconclusive/unexpected verdicts (including
SAFE_TO_RETIRE) are displayed as such and never converted. Original CLI exit
codes preserved; no mutation, publication or credentials. 23 adversarial tests
in tests/test_b4_launcher_verdict.py. POSIX preflight now validates interpreter
candidates instead of trusting the python3 name (fixes the Windows Git Bash
WindowsApps python3 stub found during rehearsal).

Ten-scene video contract (W25 scope): all current-state nine-scene text
removed; SC-07 narration corrected to 'HTTP four-oh-three, forbidden'; SC-06
given conditional LIVE/HISTORICAL narration gated on a fresh browser read (a
historical HTTP 200 never automatically becomes current; Level 2 stays
NOT_OBSERVED); SC-05 verdict grounding rule added; complete narration-matching
timed subtitle track committed (assets/demo/subtitles/termivance_demo_en.srt,
29 cues, 174 s) with on-screen slogans labeled separately.

Screenshot register unified: ONE authoritative primary selection (01/02/04/
06/07; alternates 03/05) across Master Plan 12.1, screenshots README and the
Turkish operator guide; repair-set/freshness navigation corrected to Evidence
& Audit -> 'Deterministic decision'.

Safe live rehearsal: .bat 21.1 s / .sh (Git Bash) 25.4 s, both exit 0 with
VERDICT_CONFIRMED_BLOCKED (7/7 steps, 6 live provider steps); safety refusal
early-fails 1.5 s (exit 2); Control Room five-tab browser pass; Duo session UI
404 / Issue #5 notes 401 anonymous (fallbacks valid); disposable Pages site
fresh HTTP 200 with marker at rehearsal time; committed evidence untouched.

Claims reconciliation: previously accepted W27/W28 register entries reconciled
to CLOSED_INDEPENDENT_QA with recorded acceptance chains; W23/W24/W25 remain
IMPLEMENTED_NOT_VERIFIED pending Checkpoint A; Devpost CI/observer references
labeled historical verified baselines; suite count synchronized to 563
(540 + 23 new tests).

Verification: 563 tests passed, ruff clean, 40/40 network-free safety
assertions. Zero personal spend; no destructive operation, no Pages DELETE,
no new Duo invocation, no public UI deployment, no filming, no manufactured
screenshots, no YouTube upload, no Devpost submission.
